verdict.rationale: Statsig's own Web Analytics product is documented as tracking page views and autocapture events. Setup takes only a few lines of code, which fits the no-per-event-tracking goal. But the evidence is a single overview line that never names clicks or form interactions as autocaptured events, and it describes no configuration depth. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that clicks and form interactions are autocaptured, detail on how autocapture works and how it is configured, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a product-manager, I can capture clicks, pageviews, and form interactions automatically without writing tracking code for each event

citations.quote: Overview of Statsig Web Analytics for tracking page views, autocapture events, conversions, and running A/B tests on your website.
Get data flowing into Statsig with only a few lines of code.
